51082915.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human IDO1 by SPR assay

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: The surface plasmon resonance (SPR) was carried out at 25 °C on Biacore T100 instruments using sensor chip CMS (GE Healthcare). PBS was used as running buffer with 0.1% dodecylmaltoside, 0.05 mM EDTA, and 5% DMSO, pH 7.4. The K_D value of the tested compound was determined by BIA evaluation software (GE Healthcare).
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Figure 5. SPR assay of the binding between human IDO-1 and 5c. SPR curve for the binding of IDO-1 with 5c is shown. The concentrations of 5c injected over the biosensor chip surface immobilized with IDO-1 protein are indicated. The measurement yielded a K_D of 46.8 μM.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: PBS with 0.1% dodecylmaltoside, 0.05 mM EDTA, and 5% DMSO
